page.layout: One page of text at top, full width; below it three geometric diagrams (two circles side by side above one concentric pair of circles); a signature mark at the lower right of the text area.

main_text.p: Tertij Euclidis. In æqualibus uero circulis simi-les seu ἀνάλογοι, & in Circulis æqualibus per-petuo eandem inter se rationem habent anguli, quam arcus angulis obtensi, siue ad centra siue ad peripherias circulorum constituerint. Itidem se-ctorum eadem ratio est, quæ arcuum, siquidem sectores ad centrum consistunt per 33 Sexti. Ergo sicut se sector ad sectorem habet, sic angulus ad angulum.
main_text.l: [diagram: two circles with inscribed angles at centre, level 1]
[diagram: concentric circles with inscribed angles, level 1]

page.notes: The head line is set in italic with long-s words; "Tertij Euclidis." is a running title-like opening, printed in the text block. Greek words ἀνάλογοι transcribed as printed. The diagrams are described, not transcribed. A printed mark "S E" appears at lower right and is treated as a signature. A digitiser's watermark "http://rcin.org.pl" at the bottom is omitted. Some ink smudges and stains are present but are not text.
